sources.text: Synthetic packet: Issue C is a non-deliverable indicative bond; its price cannot be used to fulfill this contract. The other quotes share the initial cutoff.

Synthetic governing terms: All price quotes are per100 face; each lot is one million face. Buy one eligible issue and short its matching delivery futures exposure. At delivery receive futures price times conversion factor plus delivery accrued, and retain the stated intervening coupon without reinvestment. Repo funds the non-haircut portion of dirty value, while haircut equity bears an identical stipulated cost of funds. Apply the stated repo rate to full dirty value at simple ACT/360. Futures margin has no funding cost or interest in this packet; haircut equity and futures margin must both be available at time0. Choose none or1–10 lots of one issue to maximize total net carry, then minimize upfront capital, issue ID and lots. A later delivery obligation may exclude none.

outputs.name: selected_issue

outputs.name: upfront_capital
outputs.description: Cash haircut equity plus futures margin.

outputs.name: net_carry
outputs.description: Cash-delivery proceeds and interim coupon less dirty purchase cost and its stipulated financing charge.

outputs.name: eligible_issue_count
outputs.description: Number of deliverable issues; ineligible indicative quotes never count.

outputs.name: delivery_commitment_met
outputs.description: Whether selected lots meet the current minimum delivery obligation.
